content.text: How can I modify the usage_tracker.py to include the new 'session_duration' metric?

You can add a new attribute to the UserSession class in usage_tracker.py. Here's a quick modification:

```python
class UserSession:
    def __init__(self, user_id, start_time, end_time):
        self.user_id = user_id
        self.start_time = start_time
        self.end_time = end_time
        self.session_duration = self.calculate_duration()

    def calculate_duration(self):
        return (self.end_time - self.start_time).seconds
```
Make sure to also update the tests accordingly.
What command should I run to test the changes I made in test_usage_tracker.py?

You can use pytest to run your test suite. Navigate to the project root in the terminal and execute:

```bash
pytest src/billing/tests/test_usage_tracker.py
```
This command will run the tests defined in test_usage_tracker.py to ensure your changes are functioning correctly.
